summary: Completed backend + frontend testing for /ai-consulting single-page flow, validation rules, country/phone sync behavior, admin route availability, and CSV/export integrity. Backend APIs passed; frontend submit integration is critically broken.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking Submit Enquiry performs native browser GET submission (URL query params with form data) instead of React onSubmit flow; no POST /api/ai-consulting-enquiries, no success/error UI, fields reset.
Typing 'India' then ArrowDown+Enter can select 'British Indian Ocean Territory' first, not India; keyboard flow works but may produce unintended selection.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend never hits backend submit endpoint from UI due event handler wiring issue; backend itself is healthy and accepts payloads via API tests.

action_items: Fix useEnquiryForm return object order so form onSubmit uses local handler with event.preventDefault and validation+API path.
Retest /ai-consulting full frontend submission after fix: 201 success message, 422/409/429/500/network error mapping, and value preservation.
Optional UX hardening: improve keyboard country search ranking to prioritize exact country matches before partial name matches.
critical_code_review_comments: Root cause is in frontend/src/pages/ai-consulting/useEnquiryForm.js: return object defines submit from local hook, then spreads ...submission, which overrides submit with useWizardSubmission.submit(payload). This breaks form event handling and preventDefault.
backend/server.py remains very large (~2300+ LOC); modular split is recommended to reduce regression surface.
Protected baseline check against git 2f576da for GetInTouchV11/get-in-touch-v11/Header/Footer/index.css showed no diff output in this run.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data retained. QA test records used only with qa.aic30.* prefix and cleaned by pytest fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Screenshots: /app/test_reports/screenshots_iter30/aic_iter30_desktop_top_1920x800.jpeg, aic_iter30_desktop_lower_1920x800.jpeg, aic_iter30_mobile_dropdown_390x844.jpeg, aic_iter30_submit_attempt3_1920x800.jpeg, admin_git_modal_iter30_1920x1080.jpeg. Frontend submit RCA reproduction used 3 attempts; third captured URL query-string submission and confirmed zero API calls. Admin /admin/get-in-touch page loads but had 0 rows at run time, so UI detail modal field rendering for new columns was not re-verified from live row in this run.
rca of the issue: Repro: fill valid /ai-consulting form and click Submit Enquiry. Observed URL changes to /ai-consulting?fullName=...&... and form resets. No /api/ai-consulting-enquiries request is sent. Cause: state.submit bound on form is overridden by spread order in useEnquiryForm return object (...submission after submit), so event.preventDefault is skipped and browser performs native form submit. Mitigation: expose local submit as final property (or rename submission.submit) so onSubmit receives event handler that validates + posts JSON.
